title: Basic-overlap comparison map
statement:
If a basic affine open $D(s)$ lies in $V_i\cap V_j$, define

$$
\omega_{ij,s}\colon
\mathsf B_{V_i}(\mathcal I)|_{D(s)}
\longrightarrow
\mathsf B_{V_j}(\mathcal I)|_{D(s)}
$$

as $r_{j,s}\circ r_{i,s}^{-1}$: first use the inverse of the restriction
isomorphism $r_{i,s}$ to move from the first local model to the blow-up of
the localized ideal, and then use $r_{j,s}$ to reach the second local model.
Both restriction maps have the blow-up of the same localized ideal as their
common source.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be quasi-coherent. For affine opens
$U\subseteq V$ of $X$ write $\mathsf B_V(\mathcal I)|_U$ for the preimage
of $U$ under the structure morphism $\mathsf B_V(\mathcal I)\to V$, and
$r_{V,U}\colon\mathsf B_U(\mathcal I)\to\mathsf B_V(\mathcal I)$ for the
transition morphism of [def-nagata-global-blowup-local-model]. The morphism
$r_{V,U}$ is an open immersion with image $\mathsf B_V(\mathcal I)|_U$, so
it induces the *restriction isomorphism*
$r_{V,U}\colon\mathsf B_U(\mathcal I)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathsf B_V(\mathcal I)|_U$.

If an affine open $U$ lies in $V_i\cap V_j$, define

$$
\omega_{ij,U}\colon
\mathsf B_{V_i}(\mathcal I)|_{U}
\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }
\mathsf B_{V_j}(\mathcal I)|_{U},
\qquad
\omega_{ij,U}=r_{V_j,U}\circ r_{V_i,U}^{-1}:
$$

first use the inverse of the restriction isomorphism $r_{V_i,U}$ to move
from the first local model to the local model $\mathsf B_U(\mathcal I)$
over $U$, and then use $r_{V_j,U}$ to reach the second local model. In
the basic case $U=D(s)$, $r_{V_i,U}$ is the morphism $r_s$ of the
localization $\Gamma(V_i,\mathcal O_X)\to\Gamma(V_i,\mathcal O_X)_s$.

proof.text:
We check that $r_{V,U}$ is an open immersion onto
$\mathsf B_V(\mathcal I)|_U$. The transition morphisms are compatible with
the structure morphisms, so $r_{V,U}$ lands in $\mathsf B_V(\mathcal I)|_U$.
If $W=D(s)\subseteq V$ is a basic open of $V$, then $\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_X)\to
\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_X)$ is a localization away from $s$ and
$\Gamma(W,\mathcal I)=\Gamma(V,\mathcal I)\,\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_X)$, so
by [prop-nagata-affine-blowup-restrict] the morphism $r_{V,W}$ is an open
immersion onto $\mathsf B_V(\mathcal I)|_W$. Now cover $U$ by opens $W$ that
are basic opens of $V$ contained in $U$; each is then also a basic open of
$U$. For such $W$ we have $r_{V,W}=r_{V,U}\circ r_{U,W}$ by functoriality
of the local models, and both $r_{V,W}$ and $r_{U,W}$ are isomorphisms onto
the parts over $W$. Hence $r_{V,U}$ maps $\mathsf B_U(\mathcal I)|_W$
isomorphically onto $\mathsf B_V(\mathcal I)|_W$. As the $W$ cover $U$,
$r_{V,U}$ is an open immersion with image $\mathsf B_V(\mathcal I)|_U$.
